from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and matching legal category."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as named in the case")
    document_number: str | None = Field(description="The document identifier, e.g. '判决文书1'")
    legal_category: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause category that this document belongs to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
